findings.issue: The module doc says that for any normal `H ≤ Deck p`, the fibre quotient by `H` is already identified with `N(H) / H`, but the exposed equivalence used in this file requires `[MulAction.IsPretransitive (Deck p) (p ⁻¹' {b})] [IsCancelSMul ...]`, and the wrapper supplies these only for regular preconnected covers.

summary: The new documentation overstates the scope of the fibre-quotient identification by omitting the freeness/transitivity or regular-preconnected hypotheses required by the declarations.
